description.narrative: Core support to Terrestrial Jerusalem, a non-governmental organisation with the purpose to monitor and analyse the geo-political situation in Jerusalem. Terrestrial Jerusalem's focus is to influence Jerusalem-centric policy with three goals in mind: 1) to prevent harmful developments that could ignite crises and derail prospects for a political solution, 2) to promote constructive, affordable and achievable interventions that can stabilise the situation and 3) to develop medium and long-term strategies that will contribute to a sustainable two-state solution.

Kärnstöd till Terrestrial Jerusalem, en civilsamhällesorganisation med syfte att följa och analysera den geopolitiska situationen i Jerusalem. Terrestrial Jerusalem avser att influera Jerusalem-centrisk policy med tre huvudmålsättningar: 1) att motverka skadlig utveckling som skulle kunna generera kriser och omöjliggöra en framtida tvåstatslösning; 2) främja konstruktiva, kostnadseffektiva och möjliga åtgärder som kan stabilisera situationen; och 3) utveckla strategier som kan bidra till en hållbar tvåstatslösning.

The overarching objective of Terrestrial Jerusalem's activities is to: protect the political, religious, territorial and cultural character of Jerusalem; to promote a just, equitable and sustainable political settlement to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict that respect the rights of all its residents; and to safeguard prospects for realizing a two-state solution.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
Despite the negative development on the ground TJ presents results and progress in line with their proposal. The Jerusalem Policy Task Force (JPTF), for example, has been a success in promoting joint efforts for (primarily international) advocacy, exchange of knowledge and education for the members.
The project has produced 66 policy proposals, well over the target of 8, that have been delivered to the US Government, the European Union and the UN. The policy proposals concern the occupation, a potential two-state solution and Jerusalem as a permanent status issue. Areas targeted in briefings and engagements with key international stakeholders include, among other topics, the planned preservation of a multifaith Jerusalem, territorial/settlement related developments (including the encirclement of the Old City), regional implications of Al Asqua and Palestinian agency in East Jerusalem. The shrinking space for marginalized Christians has also been highlighted and increasingly recognized internationally.
The tracking of the settlement plans in East Jerusalem has continued throughout the year. With much focus on Gaza after October 7th, Terrestrial Jerusalem has continued its focus on Jerusalem as they recognize this as their area of added value and an important component in preventing further escalation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
